checks.title: Feedback risk
checks.detail: Ambo microphone: about 0.5 dB short of stable gain. Lower the system level, aim loudspeakers away, move them further from the microphone, or use a headset microphone (talker 5–10 cm).

checks.title: Low feedback margin
checks.detail: Altar microphone: only 0.0 dB of margin.

checks.title: Speech clarity
checks.detail: 34 % of seats reach STI ≥ 0.60 (target: every seat). Average 0.57.

checks.title: Late arrivals (echo risk)
checks.detail: 264 seats hear a loudspeaker ≥ 50 ms after the first arrival and within 10 dB. Use “Align delays”.

checks.title: Ventilation
checks.detail: 9 exhaust fans move ≈38,880 m³/h ≈ 5.2 air changes per hour (comfort target in a hot climate with people: 4–6).
